generate_doxygen_xml: generate Doxygen XML documentation for the pybind11 C++ header files using the doxygen tool
prepare_readme_for_latex: prepare the README.rst file for LaTeX builds by removing badges and converting section titles to bold
clean_up_generated_readme: clean up and remove the generated readme.rst file after the Sphinx documentation build finishes
setup_sphinx_hooks: setup Sphinx event hooks to generate Doxygen XML, prepare the readme, and clean up after the build
configure_sphinx_for_pybind11: configure Sphinx with Breathe, Furo theme, and C++ domain for building pybind11 documentation
